payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the Transformer model outperformed the ConvS2S model across all languages tested, making it the best performing model.

claims.text: The Transformer model outperformed the ConvS2S model for all languages, achieving sometimes 10 BLEU points or more over ConvS2S.
The results show that translations using BPE tokenisation outperformed translations using standard word-based tokenisation, further favoring the Transformer model.
The ConvS2S model struggled with translations, while the Transformer model performed better overall, indicating its superior capability.
